messages:
Maria (Sales): HQV (enterprise) just sent over a SIG/CAIQ + vendor risk form and want answers by Fri EOD PT. POC is emily.h@hqv.com. Uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BHQV_SECQ. Can someone from security own intake and triage?

Ajay (Security): I'll take this on. Quick clarification — do they want a full CAIQ response or a condensed vendor form? Also need SOC2 status, encryption-at-rest details, and DPA status. Can you attach the PDF?

Maria (Sales): Attached: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HQV_SecQ_2026.pdf — it's the full CAIQ plus a 12-page appendix with environment-specific Qs.

Ajay (Security): Assigned to me. Creating internal ticket and estimating ~3 business days to produce draft answers. Any hard SLA from customer? Also, do they require BYOK?

SecurityBot: Ticket VR-2026-342 created and assigned to @Ajay (Security). Link: https://tickets.redwood.local/VR-2026-342

Devon (Solutions Eng): I can handle the technical Qs for the POC (architecture, flow, infra). Note: the POC will use ephemeral data, no PHI/PCI. If they want diagrams I can drop one into the drive.

Sarah (Customer Success): Heads-up — contract team flagged EU-only logging/residency requirement. Sales, need to confirm whether Hosted is acceptable or if Dedicated/EU deployment required.

Maria (Sales): @Sarah (Customer Success) noted. Customer prefers Hosted API for speed but said they will accept Dedicated if we can guarantee EU-only logs.

Ajay (Security): For CAIQ answers, I'll draft the following high-level points: SOC2: "In scope; Type II audit in progress, expected completion 2026-09-01"; Encryption: "AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit; customer-managed KMS available on Private/Dedicated"; Data residency: provide EU-region deployment options. Devon — can you confirm POC region and retention details?

Devon (Solutions Eng): POC infra: ```infra:
  region: eu-west-1
  logs_retention_days: 7
  poc_data: ephemeral
  kv_cache: cleared_post_session
``` I'll also add a short network diagram to the drive.

Maria (Sales): Updating the customer: "Assigned to Redwood Security. ETA ~3 business days for draft answers."

Ajay (Security): Draft answers uploaded to drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BHQV_SECQ/drafts — please review by EOD tomorrow. Tagging @Devon for infra confirmations and @Sarah for residency/contract language.

SecurityBot: Reminder set for VR-2026-342 in 48h.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Reviewed draft infra bits, commented inline. Will add diagram and sample config.

Sarah (Customer Success): I'll prepare the residency wording for the contract team and add a one-paragraph exec summary for their leadership.

Ajay (Security): I'll finalize security responses and produce a one-page summary for execs.

Maria (Sales): Thanks team. Customer also asked for an "exec one-pager" summarizing controls and risk posture. Can we add that to the drive?

Devon (Solutions Eng): Will add the technical appendix and diagram today.

Sarah (Customer Success): I'll draft the exec one-pager and share for review.

Ajay (Security): Sounds good — I'll merge the responses and close VR-2026-342 when we send.

Maria (Sales): Great — I'll let Emily (HQV) know we have an owner and an ETA. :thumbsup:
